data.summary: Product Owner / Product Manager with 11+ years of overall technology experience, including 9+ years driving product ownership for data- and analytics-heavy platforms in the US healthcare (Medicaid/Medicare) domain. Proven track record leading cross-functional Agile teams (Scrum/SAFe, Jira) to deliver data products spanning ingestion, data quality, cleansing, and lifecycle management across CRM, EHR, EMA, and RCM systems. Hands-on with Snowflake, Databricks, Qlik, ThoughtSpot, Power BI, and Azure/AWS-based data stacks, with working knowledge of AI/ML-Ops concepts, LLM fundamentals (prompting, RAG, fine-tuning, agents), and Responsible AI, data privacy, and regulatory considerations (HIPAA-adjacent healthcare compliance, CMS approvals). Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) and EXIN Agile Scrum practitioner.

Product Owner / Product Manager with 11+ years of overall technology experience, including 9+ years driving product ownership for data- and analytics-heavy platforms in the US healthcare (Medicaid/Medicare) domain. Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) and EXIN Agile Scrum practitioner.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Product & Delivery: Product Ownership, Product Roadmap & Strategy, User Story Writing, Backlog Management, Agile/Scrum/SAFe, Jira, Stakeholder Management
Data & AI: Data Management, Data Quality & Cleansing, Data Lifecycle, Data Governance, AI/ML-Ops (working knowledge), DevOps (working knowledge), LLM Concepts (Prompting, RAG, Fine-tuning, Agents), Responsible/Explainable AI, AI Data Privacy & Compliance (foundational)
AI-Augmented Analytics: Snowflake Cortex, Databricks AI/BI Genie, Qlik Insight Advisor / AutoML, ThoughtSpot Spotter, Natural-Language Querying, AI-Assisted Anomaly Detection
Tech Stack: Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Azure, Qlik, ThoughtSpot, Power BI, SQL Scripting, CRM Platforms, Vector Search / Embeddings (conceptual)
Healthcare Domain: EHR, EMA, RCM, FHIR/HL7, CMS-Regulated Data, US Medicaid & Medicare, Data Privacy & Security Awareness
raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Product Owner — Data & Analytics   |   Modmed
Aug 2024 – Present  •  Hyderabad
Serve as Product Owner for the Data & Analytics team, owning the roadmap for reporting and data-quality initiatives across clinical and operational data domains.
Partner with engineering and analytics teams using Qlik, Databricks, and ThoughtSpot to define, prioritize, and deliver self-service reporting and data products for internal and clinical stakeholders.
Drive data quality, cleansing, and lifecycle requirements across EHR (Electronic Health Records), EMA, and RCM (Revenue Cycle Management) source systems, ensuring downstream analytics accuracy.
Translate business and clinical requirements into user stories and backlog items, managing delivery through Agile ceremonies and Jira.
Collaborate with data engineering to define data pipeline requirements, quality checks, and governance standards feeding the analytics layer.
Evaluate and champion AI-augmented analytics capabilities (e.g., natural-language querying and AI-assisted insight generation within the Qlik/ThoughtSpot/Databricks stack) to accelerate self-service reporting for clinical and business stakeholders.
Technical Product Owner   |   Nations Benefits
Mar 2017 – Jul 2024  •  Hyderabad
Owned the product roadmap for the OTC (Over-the-Counter) e-commerce platform, serving 8,000+ healthcare providers and health plan members across the US healthcare market.
Spearheaded the FHIR initiative, enabling secure data exchange in HL7 format for 50 million+ members, directly involving data standardization, quality, and lifecycle management.
Owned product delivery for a CRM-based Call Center platform supporting appointment, order, payment, and benefit history data across 150+ healthcare insurance providers.
Led end-to-end onboarding of 200+ healthcare providers onto the Nations Benefits COBT platform, managing site and benefit configuration data quality.
Applied SAFe/Agile methodologies to break down features into user stories, manage backlogs, and track delivery through Jira across multiple cross-functional squads.
Grew with the organization from its second employee to a workforce of 4,000+, gaining broad exposure to QA, development, production support, and business analysis functions.
Project Coordinator   |   Credible Technologies
Mar 2016 – Mar 2017  •  Hyderabad
Managed large-scale technology rollouts, including the NEP Portal, across 1,500+ sites in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, meeting deadline, budget, and quality benchmarks.
Coordinated stakeholder engagement, vendor management, risk management, and regulatory compliance for statewide project delivery.
MATLAB Tutor / Project Delivery   |   Pantech Pvt Ltd
Jun 2015 – Mar 2016  •  Hyderabad
Delivered 300+ academic and industry projects in Digital Signal Processing (DSP) and Digital Image Processing (DIP) using MATLAB, translating client requirements into working solutions.
Managed project timelines, resources, and quality across a high volume of concurrent deliverables.
Vice President – Membership, Elan Toastmasters Club (Jan 2019 – Present)
Speaker/Attendee, TiE Global Summit 2022 — New Age Entrepreneurship
